snippets.snippet_text: "Overall, Amazon tends to attract more price-sensitive buyers who want things quickly. Even with Handmade items, customers may expect an 'Amazon experience' overall with free, fast shipping. Etsy shoppers tend to value unique items made by individuals. They may be more willing to wait for something unique or made to order."

intake_notes: nav.com Amazon vs Etsy blog (October 7, 2022). Buyer preference comparison: Amazon attracts price-sensitive buyers expecting fast shipping; Etsy buyers value unique/individual-made items and tolerate longer wait times.
possible_subjects: Amazon vs Etsy buyer types: Amazon attracts price-sensitive/fast-shipping buyers; Etsy attracts buyers valuing unique handmade items
